description: Figure 8 illustrates the results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as the pruning method and a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from Layer 4 to Layer 28, with tick labels at each layer number. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and has a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick labels at 2.5% intervals. There are four lines displayed on the plot. The first line, colored blue and marked with a triangle, represents “LB-Arg of 2-tokens, 8-bit” and begins at approximately 0% at Layer 4, decreases to -12.5% at Layer 5-12, then increases to approximately 0% at Layer 28. The second line, colored blue and marked with a square, represents “LB-Arg of 1-token, 16-bit” and begins at approximately 0% at Layer 4, decreases to -10% at Layer 5-12, then increases to approximately 0% at Layer 28. The third line, colored red and marked with a circle, represents “Baseline of 4-tokens, 8-bit” and begins at approximately 0% at Layer 4, decreases to -15% at Layer 5-12, then increases to approximately 0% at Layer 28. The fourth line, colored red and marked with a diamond, represents “RULERd of 1-tokens, 16-bit” and begins at approximately 0% at Layer 4, decreases to -12.5% at Layer 5-12, then increases to approximately 0% at Layer 28.
